description: Pauses one of the signed-in member's alerts (Price Alert or Custom Alert, its id from alerts_list): it stays saved and stops firing until alerts_resume. Returns the alert in words. It changes the member's account, so the chat app may ask the user to confirm first. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

alert_id.description: The alert's id, from alerts_list or the result that created it.
